name: The High Preceptor's Petition: Astropathic Cry to Primarch Guilliman

cycle_advancement.world_state: Astropathic Macro-Vox Distress Beam Transmitted — Awaiting Space Marine Drop

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The 60-foot golden Imperial Aquila radiates blinding sapphire power as Confessor Malachi channels the Sol-Aegis Plasma Reactor directly into the high spire astropathic choir. A planetary-scale distress beacon pierces Hive Tartarus's orbital quarantine: 'CHAOS GOD LORD ENGAGED. SEND THE ADEPTUS ASTARTES. IN THE NAME OF GUILLIMAN, HEAR US!'

completed_milestones.title: Astropathic Distress Hymn Dispatched to Primarch Roboute Guilliman
completed_milestones.consequence: Confessor Preceptor Malachi assumed supreme command of Sub-Level 404, wired the Sol-Aegis Plasma Reactor into the Basilica astropathic relays, and successfully transmitted a high-priority distress hymn across the sector to Lord Commander Roboute Guilliman and the Adeptus Astartes.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Vigil of the Martyr's Crown
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: Lord Malgakor (5,068 HP) is staggering up the chasm toward the Basilica, while the Ultramarines Strike Cruiser 'Honor of Macragge' breaks orbit to deploy drop-pods.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Hold the Basilica gates with the Kastelan Automaton 'Iron Bastion' and surviving heavy weapons teams until the Adeptus Astartes drop-pods slam into the abyss.

command_and_specialists.name: Confessor Preceptor Malachi
command_and_specialists.role: Acting Garrison Commander & Voice of the Emperor

new_decision.decision: Assumed supreme command of Sub-Level 404 following Sergeant Vane's martyrdom; mounted the high altar of the Basilica of Saint Katherine's Tears, linked the Sol-Aegis Plasma Reactor to the high-gain astropathic array, and bellowed a sector-wide distress transmission directly to High Command and Primarch Roboute Guilliman: 'WE HAVE ENGAGED A CHAOS GOD. VANE HAS FALLEN. SEND THE ADEPTUS ASTARTES!'
new_decision.impact: Pierced planetary quarantine shielding with an unignorable divine-grade distress signal; rallied surviving conscripts and enforcers with holy fire.
